gloss: first thing in the afternoon; 1 PM; right after lunch

definitions.gloss: first thing in the afternoon; right after lunch
definitions.explanation: the earliest time slot in the afternoon, typically meaning 1 PM or immediately after the lunch break

examples.japanese: {午後一|ごごいち}で{会議|かいぎ}がある。
examples.english: There's a meeting first thing in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {午後一|ごごいち}の{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせに{間|ま}に{合|あ}うように{戻|もど}る。
examples.english: I'll be back in time for the 1 PM meeting.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み{明|あ}けの{午後一|ごごいち}は{眠|ねむ}くなりがちだ。
examples.english: You tend to get sleepy right after lunch when the afternoon starts.

notes:
Colloquial abbreviation of {午後|ごご}{一番|いちばん} (first thing in the afternoon). Very common in workplace Japanese for scheduling. The {一|いち} here means "first" (as in the first slot), not literally 1 o'clock, though in practice it usually means around 1 PM or 13:00. Follows the same pattern as {朝一|あさいち} (first thing in the morning).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {午後一|ごごいち}で: first thing in the afternoon
- {午後一|ごごいち}の{会議|かいぎ}: afternoon's first meeting
- {午後一|ごごいち}に{入|はい}る: to start in the early afternoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝一|あさいち}: first thing in the morning — the same pattern for the morning
- {午後|ごご}{一番|いちばん}: first thing in the afternoon — the full, unabbreviated form
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎ: early afternoon — a more general term for after noon
